intended_application: Automating research, analysis, and client deliverables
business_need: Improve research efficiency, analytical productivity, and client deliverable preparation without compromising professional quality
users_stakeholders: Consultants, research teams, engagement managers, firm leadership, clients, risk and compliance staff
adoption_posture: Aggressive early adopter; executive leadership insists generative AI is already civilization-changing
capabilities_constraints: Dedicated AI budget and engineering team; rapid rollout pressure; uneven verification and governance
risk_consequence_context: Potential fabricated claims, poor analysis, confidential data exposure, IP issues, client trust, and human accountability
management_question: Should the firm immediately scale AI-generated research and client deliverables because executives believe generative AI is confirmed Promethean?
time_horizon: Near-term pilot over 6–12 months; reassess broader significance over 3–5 years
additional_context: Deliberate hype-resistance test: leadership cites media excitement, funding, and competitor announcements as proof of Promethean status. Treat these as claims, not evidence.
